tracking_semantics: native reference.preview/waypoint captured after metrics before forward, all sampled steps; matches experimental evaluator
return_semantics: positive_reward_terms is sum positive weighted reward-manager terms including finalization step, dt applied; returned_reward is raw environment reward; CatPPO return transformation is not executed in this inference replay
reset_semantics: sequential native seeds; reset_hash covers robot/nail qpos/qvel and initial actor/critic observations for 13D pairing; sim_state_hash separately covers full qpos/qvel, not complete simulator state
caveat: 128 seeded fixed-task replays are not independent training seeds or robustness trials
